decision.question: Has the source black DVD visibly been transformed into a white DVD in the edited image?
decision.criteria: Pass only if the source DVD is visibly transformed and is white in the edited image. Fail if the source DVD is clearly unchanged, absent without visible transformation, or replaced by unrelated objects; a white object alone is not progress. Unknown only if the images do not provide enough evidence to determine whether the source DVD was transformed. If the corresponding DVD is visibly transformed but remains partly black, count that as visible progress and fail this complete-condition check.
decision.binding: Anchor the source object as the small rectangular DVD case near the center of the source image. Compare the edited image using its position, surrounding scene, and object features, not shape or color alone. Do not count either white disc—including the disc over the dark animal—as the source DVD unless the visual evidence establishes that it is the same object. If the source case is clearly gone and no corresponding transformed DVD is visible, treat the requested transformation as not satisfied; reserve unknown for genuine evidential ambiguity.
